request.description: Public registration. Creates an unverified tenant, stores a bcrypt OTP hash in Redis for 10 minutes, sends SMTP email. No tokens or cookies. Supply a real inbox in registrationEmail. 409 for duplicate email, 400 for invalid body/extra role field, 429 after 10 valid requests/IP per 15 minutes, 503 for configured service failures. Verification email includes responsive Homi HTML and plain text, personalized greeting, actual backend OTP expiry and security warning. Use a fresh email or Gmail plus alias for repeat email-design testing.

response.name: 201 - Verification required

request.description: Public email verification. Use the code from Gmail within the registration 600-second expiry. Maximum five attempts. Correct verification marks the user verified and consumes the Redis code without issuing tokens. 400 invalid/expired, 409 already verified, 429 attempt limit, 403 inactive account.

request.description: Resend a verification code for an existing active unverified account. Replaces the prior code, resets attempts, expires in 600 seconds, and enforces a 60-second cooldown plus 10 valid requests/IP/15 minutes. Verified/unknown/inactive accounts receive generic success without mail. 429 cooldown, 400 validation, 503 service failure.
